title: Day two. Soulmate. Leo: obviously.
caption: "Soulmate" on day two and nonstop gifts can feel dazzling, especially to a Leo. Big romance isn't the problem; intensity that later turns into pressure is. Real interest goes at your pace. If it's real, it'll still be real next week.
